Definition: from the same as G5622; to be useful, i.e. to benefit:--advantage, better, prevail, profit.
BiblicalUsage: To profit is to gain by something, and the New Testament keeps asking what actually profits. Paul says that giving away all my goods and even my body to be burned profits me nothing without love, and that circumcision profits nothing if you are justified by the law.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that profit is measured by love, not by gain: the most impressive sacrifice is worth nothing if love is missing.
